mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for new construction, which correlates with higher consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.1% signals a monetary policy tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.1, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.5 indicates a supply shock that reduces corporate output and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 99.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand across multiple sectors, which correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS increases fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.35), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.35, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
